aseg_stats.Description: Per-structure volumetric statistics for the subcortical segmentation. Read into `freesurfer_aseg`, plus the `# Measure` scalars into `freesurfer_measures`.

wmparc_stats.Description: The same table for the white-matter parcellation. Same suffix as `aseg_stats`, distinguished only by `seg`, which is why the term map declares that entity literally rather than capturing it.

aparc_stats.Description: Per-region cortical morphometry for the Desikan-Killiany atlas, one file per hemisphere. `{hemi}` is a placeholder rather than a declared entity: it varies per render, and a role's entities describe what is true of every file in the slot. Note it binds the FreeSurfer *filename* token (`lh`/`rh`); the entity the term map projects from that path is the BIDS label (`L`/`R`), which is a different string on purpose.

aparc_a2009s_stats.Description: The Destrieux atlas counterpart. The `parc` value carries a dot because it is a projection of the filename, not a BIDS label — nothing renders it into a name.

curv_stats.Description: A free-text curvature report, not a table at all. It reaches the catalog as a path because the term map's `?h.*.stats` mapping claims it, and it declares no suffix — which is exactly what keeps the `fs_stats` reader away from a file it could not parse.

brainvol_stats.Description: Whole-brain volumes, written as `# Measure` comment lines with no table beneath them. Claimed by the `stats/` catch-all, so no suffix and no reader.

annot_ctab.Description: The colour lookup table for the parcellation: id, name, RGBA, headerless and column-aligned. Read by the `matrix` engine, whose column order comes from the overlay's `initial_columns`.

aparc_annot.Description: The binary per-vertex parcellation assignment. Cataloged, never read.

cortex_label.Description: The cortex vertex list. An ASCII format the catalog still only records a path for, since nothing declares a table for it.

aseg_mgz.Description: The subcortical segmentation volume. `dseg` is base BIDS vocabulary, which is why this role needs no overlay suffix even though its path carries no entities.

wmparc_mgz.Description: The white-matter parcellation volume — what FEAT's `reg/wmparc.nii.gz` role is resampled from, one dataset over.

aparc_aseg_mgz.Description: Cortical parcellation merged into the subcortical segmentation. The `+` in the filename is why the term map enumerates these five volumes by alternation instead of capturing a label.

t1_mgz.Description: The conformed T1. Claimed by the `mri/*.mgz` catch-all with no `seg`, which is the distinction the enumerated alternation above exists to preserve: a projection that captured a label here would read this file as `seg-T1`.

talairach_xfm.Description: The affine to Talairach space. Nested one level deeper than every other `mri/` role, and claimed by the `mri/.+` mapping rather than the `mri/*.mgz` one.

white_surf.Description: The white-matter surface. Extensionless, like most of `surf/` — the term map claims the whole subtree by position, since there is no name here to parse.

pial_surf.Description: The pial surface. In a real `recon-all` tree this is a relative symlink to `?h.pial.T1`; the layout names the slot, not how the filesystem fills it.

inflated_surf.Description: The inflated surface, for visualization. Its `?h.inflated.H`/`.K` companions are curvature measures of it, carry no BIDS term, and stay on the catch-all.

sphere_surf.Description: The spherical surface. `?h.sphere.reg` is the registered form — a different file with no BIDS term — so the mapping matches this name exactly rather than by prefix.

smoothwm_surf.Description: The smoothed white-matter surface. The eight `?h.smoothwm.*.crv` files beside it are curvature derivatives with no BIDS term.

recon_log.Description: The run log. Declares no concepts at all, and that is the point: the term map recognizes `scripts/` so the validator does not call it un-BIDS, while projecting nothing, so no ingestion rule claims it and it earns no scan row.

recon_done.Description: The completion marker. Recognized and unclaimed, as `recon_log` is.

touch_marker.Description: One per completed `recon-all` step — around seventy in a finished tree. The ingestion fragment's first rule `ignore`s the whole directory, so these are the one part of the tree that is recognized, unclaimed, and deliberately not even recorded.

Examples.x_note: The session form. FreeSurfer flattens both entities into one directory name, which is the shape one PCRE mapping collapses.

The sessionless form, with the other hemisphere so both bindings of every `{hemi}` role are round-tripped — and so both halves of the term map's `hemi: L` / `hemi: R` split are exercised, since a capture group could not produce a label that is not in the path.
A bare label with no `sub-` prefix — FreeSurfer's own convention, and the third form the subject template admits.
